init_decoder_params: initialize Lightplane renderer decoder MLP parameters with Xavier initialization for trunk, opacity, and color MLPs
init_splatter_params: initialize Lightplane splatter MLP parameters with Xavier initialization for 3D feature grid splatting
flatten_decoder_params: flatten trunk, opacity, and color MLP weight matrices and bias vectors into a single contiguous tensor
flattened_decoder_params_to_list: unflatten a 1D MLP parameter tensor back into separate weight matrices and bias vectors for each MLP
get_triton_function_input_dims: extract MLP layer counts and hidden unit dimensions from decoder params for Triton kernel configuration
